title: BYOK desktop / package evidence (per target)
description: Machine-readable evidence for real desktop WebDriver or macOS packaged smoke. Mocked Playwright must use harnessType mocked-playwright-not-desktop and must not claim production desktop pass.

commitSha.description: Git commit SHA of the build under test.

harnessType.description: How the evidence was produced. host-binary-smoke exercises production Rust in the built binary without WebView IPC/WebDriver. desktop-webdriver is reserved for real WebDriver. mocked-playwright-not-desktop is never real desktop E2E.

productionBinaryMarker.description: True when host-binary-smoke exercised production Rust modules inside the built binary. Not a substitute for productionIpcMarker (webview/Tauri IPC).

binarySha256.description: SHA-256 of the built app binary, or not-built/unknown when blocked.

packageSha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the installer/package artifact.

productionIpcMarker.description: Must be true only when production Tauri WebView command/event IPC was exercised (desktop-webdriver). Must be false for host-binary-smoke, macos-packaged-smoke binary paths, blocked, and mocked runs.

result.description: Overall outcome. blocked = harness/binary not available (fail-closed honesty).

artifactPaths.description: Relative or absolute paths to logs, screenshots, and related artifacts.

notes.description: Optional human-readable context (e.g. macOS WebDriver limitation).
